    Does a stored fit's year climate term differ from this run's settings?

    storedYearClimateProblem.Rd

    A fit stored in the ledger carries the term it was made with (modelList$yearClimate; shape with yearClimateShape = "logistic" (with its bounds), weights with yearClimateWeights = "climate"). The term must be there exactly when ignitionYearClimate (escapeYearClimate) is set, of the same variable (with or without underscores). Where both the stored fit and this run have a term, yearClimateShape, the bounds of a logistic one (logisticYearBounds) and yearClimateWeights must agree. A fit stored before these parameters existed has neither shape, bounds, weights nor an escape term: it matches only their defaults, and one made before the ignition term existed is refitted when ignitionYearClimate is set.

    storedYearClimateProblem(fitted, igOrEsc, par)

    Arguments

    fitted

    A stored list(modelList = ...), or NULL.

    igOrEsc

    "ignition" or "escape".

    par

    The module's parameters (P(sim)): ignitionYearClimate, escapeYearClimate, yearClimateShape, yearClimateWeights.

    Value

    NULL if they agree, else a sentence saying how they differ.
